 BTS , Stranger Things and Percy Jackson and the Olympians were among the big winners at today’s Kid’s Choice Awards on CBS and Nickelodeon .
 BTS took the award for Favorite Music Group or Duo, while Stranger Things was named Favorite Family TV Show. Individual acting awards went to Jack Griffo (Max Thunderman, The Thundermans: Undercover ) and Jenna Ortega (Wednesday Addams, Wednesday ), among others, while Favorite Song From A Movie went to KPop Demon Hunters ‘ “Golden.”
 See the complete awards list below.

 Hosted by multiplatinum recording artist Alex Warren, the KCAs aired simultaneously today on CBS and Nickelodeon (5–6:30 p.m./PT; 8–9:30 p.m./ET). The show streamed live on Paramount+ for Premium subscribers, with on-demand viewing available tomorrow for both Premium and Essential subscribers in the U.S. The show will also be available globally on Paramount+ following its linear premiere on Nickelodeon and CBS.
 Watch on Deadline 
 The KCAs are fan-picked honors across movies, TV, music, sports, digital and more, with Nickelodeon’s signature Orange Blimp trophies awarded throughout the presentation.
 Here’s the complete list of winners:
